hook.name: RobinHook
hook.description: Detects and surcharges sandwich back-runs and JIT liquidity strategies, routing captured MEV to pool liquidity providers via a per-pool MEV-sharing ledger. Implements dynamic LP fee overrides with a drawbridge surcharge mechanism, a base holder fee on every swap, a per-block price-band circuit breaker, and optional swap-triggered Robin NFT minting for ROBIN token buyers.
